source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Determine the duration of each permit deviation or violation.
3. Determine which compounds were released.
4. Determine which TCLP metals were released.
5. Determine the quantity of each compound released.
6. Document all excessive emission events or each compound in a report.
  Document the frequency (number of times) in which each compound was released in each excessive emission event.
  Document the cumulative quantity of each compound released in each excessive emission event.
7. Report the results of all excessive emission events in a risk assessment.
